The single source of truth for humans and coding agents (Copilot, Claude,
Cursor, Hermes, etc.) working on Trishula is
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
in the [`trishula`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula) repository.
Tool-specific files (`CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) point
there; when anything disagrees, **AGENTS.md wins**.

Read it at the source — the GitHub-rendered page is always current, with
the file's own table of contents at its usual anchors:

- [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/AGENTS.md) —
  the guide: project map, testing standard, layer map, signing, the ADR
  process ([`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/tree/main/docs/adr)),
  PR contract, labels, security rules.
- [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) —
  the working agreement (ground rules, PR template).

## Architecture Decision Records

Structural changes carry an ADR in the same PR. Most slices are
leaf-sized — the issue's PRD reference IS the design record, no ADR
needed — write one only when the change **introduces a new persistent
artifact** or **removes or changes one**: a wire format, a kernel map
layout, a CRD field, a gate script.

The record home is
[`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/tree/main/docs/adr) —
[the process](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/docs/adr/0000-architecture-decision-records.md)
and [the record format](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-record-format.md).

Rules with teeth:

- **Accepted ADRs are immutable.** A change that contradicts an accepted
  ADR supersedes it with a new one; the accepted record is never rewritten.
- **Never invent discussion, deciders or quotes.** Cite commit/issue
  permalinks, or write "No substantive technical discussion recorded".
- Bug fixes, docs, CI and dependency bumps don't need ADRs.

This page intentionally does not mirror the file: a mirror drifts the moment
the repo moves, and the source-of-truth rule (AGENTS.md wins) already says
where to look.
